info.name: Cine Cinema - Complete API Tests
info.description:
Comprehensive API test collection for the Cine Cinema (Cinema Side) Spring Boot application. Covers authentication, cinema profile, movies, posters, showtimes, seat availability, reservations (dev profile), catalog publishing, and security/negative tests.

Environment variables required:
- baseUrl: e.g. http://localhost:8082
- token: JWT token (auto-set by login request)
- cinemaId, movieId, showtimeId, reservationShowtimeId, reservationId, testShowDate, testShowTime, confirmedReservationId
